title: Move of an MS Teams integration into a project that already has one is rejected with 'Project mismatch', not by the singleton rule
manual_steps: Create projects A and B that you administer, each with its own MS Teams integration
Open A's MS Teams integration, change its Project to B and save (or PUT with project_name = B)
Observe a 4xx whose reason is 'Project mismatch' rather than a conflict/duplicate message
List MS Teams integrations of A and B to check nothing moved
expected: 4xx rejection that is not the 'Project mismatch' text; B keeps one integration
actual: 400 'Project mismatch'; the singleton rule is not what rejects the move
control_experiment: not run: the stand has no build without the change
